    'Thomas': 'yes',
    'Caitlin': 'no',
    'David': 'yes',
    'Brandon': 'yes',
    'Sierra': 'no',
    'Sabrina': 'no',
    'Kayla': 'no',
    'Ashlee': 'yes',
    'Vickie': 'no',
    'Tracy': 'yes'
}

# Parse the CSV content
lines = csv_data.strip().split('\n')
header = lines[0]
rows = lines[1:]

# Update each row
updated_rows = []
for row in rows:
    parts = row.split(',')
    name = parts[0].strip()
    invited = parts[1].strip()
    # Determine new RSVP
    new_rsvp = rsvp_updates.get(name, 'unknown')
    updated_rows.append(f"{name},{invited},{new_rsvp}")

# Build new content
new_content = header + '\n' + '\n'.join(updated_rows) + '\n'
print(new_content)
